thread:
customer_acme: Hi team — during our investor demo this morning we started getting spikes of `429 Too Many Requests` and intermittent `401` auth errors. Demo happened around 09:12 PT. We're on the Free tier. Any chance of a short-term concurrency bump? We can't upgrade mid-demo without guidance.

sara_support: Sorry about that 🙇‍♀️ Can you paste a request ID or sample `curl` output? Also which endpoint (completion / embeddings)?

customer_acme: Completions API. Here's a snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: req_01FZ...abcd
Retry-After: 10
content-type: application/json
{"error":{"message":"Rate limit exceeded"}}
```
And some sessions returned `401`:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":{"message":"Invalid API key"}}
```

devon_engineer: @sara_support looks like two separate issues — quota/concurrency hit and an invalid key rotation somewhere. 429s line up to short burst above free concurrency (we throttle at ~4 concurrent streams on free plan). 401s look like a key mismatch from the demo script that reloaded env vars.

sara_support: Thanks @devon_engineer. @customer_acme — can you confirm the API key you used matches the one on the Dashboard -> API keys? Also did you have multiple team members using the same key concurrently?

customer_acme: We had two interns and the demo runner hitting endpoints concurrently (~6 streams). We also ran an automated token refresh script that swapped in an obsolete key for a minute (hence 401). We didn't realize free plan concurrency was that low.

sara_support: Understood. Short-term options:
• We can issue a temporary demo uplift (30m) to raise concurrency to 12 and increase token rate limits, subject to security check.
• Quick mitigation: rotate to a single dedicated key for the demo runner and disable the refresh script.
• Long-term: upgrade to Starter paid tier for predictable higher concurrency and invoice-backed billing.

customer_acme: How do we request the temporary uplift? Need approvals from finance — can sales help with urgency?

amy_sales: I can assist — @sara_support pls start a support ticket escalation and cc me. We can approve a 1-hour demo uplift and open a Starter trial quote for the account. Need billing org and company domain.

sara_support: Created escalation S-2325-78. @customer_acme please DM billing org id + domain (or paste here if OK). Once we verify identity we'll enable the uplift within 15 minutes. Also we'll link you to the Starter trial docs and a migration checklist.

infra-bot: [rate-limit-monitor] Detected 6 concurrent streams for key req_01FZ...abcd at 2026-03-17T16:12:05Z — applied soft-throttle (free plan) -> 429s emitted.

devon_engineer: After the uplift we'll recommend these config changes:
- Use a single key per session
- Exponential backoff with jitter on 429 (start retry after Retry-After)
- Add lightweight client-side concurrency limiter (max 4 for free, 12 for demo uplift)

customer_acme: Great — sending billing org in DM. Appreciate the quick turnaround. Any notes on cost for Starter?

amy_sales: I'll follow up in the ticket with pricing. Starter is per-month with commit or pay-as-you-go options. For the demo uplift we'll not charge separately but will require an active billing contact.

sara_support: Closing loop here once uplift applied. If you still see `401` after rotating keys, paste the header samples and we'll trace. :thumbsup:
